source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with monumental pale cliffs, dark ink pines and shrubs, small pavilion compounds, misty water flats with birds, winding banks, bridges, and foreground groves. Calligraphy and seals in the upper/right margins are excluded from motif selection.

motifs.name: left_sheer_cliff_with_pines
motifs.description: Tall left-side vertical cliff face with layered pale wash, dark fissure lines, sparse shrubs, and clusters of pines clinging to ledges along the upper and middle slopes.
must_preserve: soft ochre-gray cliff wash and broad blank rock planes
thin vertical crack lines and darker ravine strokes
dark pine crowns with fine needle-dot texture
small shrubs scattered along ledges
irregular mist-softened cliff edges

motifs.name: central_crag_ridge_pines
motifs.description: Massive central mountain crag rising from the midground, including the jagged ridge line, pale rock planes, central vertical clefts, and dense pine groups on the crest and left shoulder.
must_preserve: angular ridge silhouette against open mist
long vertical texture strokes on rock face
dark crevice at lower left of crag
rounded pine canopies along the crest
fine dotted vegetation on slopes and ledges

motifs.name: right_receding_mountain_spur
motifs.description: Pale right-side receding mountain spur and saddle, with rounded rock forms, soft washes, dotted shrubs, and dark ravine notch at the base; exclude nearby red seals.
must_preserve: light translucent mountain wash
thin contour lines defining rounded slopes
dark notch and shadow at the saddle
small dotted shrub clusters
misty softened lower edge

motifs.name: midleft_hidden_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Small pavilion and house roofs tucked into the left midground hillside beneath dense trees, with sloping tiled roofs, railings, trunks, and surrounding dark foliage.
must_preserve: individual sloped roof geometry
fine roof-edge and railing linework
dark clustered tree masses partially obscuring buildings
vertical trunks behind the roofs
hillside contour wash around the compound

motifs.name: misty_water_birds_and_islets
motifs.description: Broad misty water plain across the lower middle with scattered flocks of tiny dark birds, low sandy islets, sparse reeds, and faint shoreline contours.
must_preserve: open pale wash of water and mist
tiny V-shaped and dot-like bird marks
thin curving shoreline lines
low reed and grass strokes on islets
subtle tonal transitions at the banks

motifs.name: central_river_island_with_bridge
motifs.description: Narrow curving river island and bank in the lower middle-right, including a small simple bridge or landing structure, low shrubs, water channels, and nearby shoreline trees.
must_preserve: thin horizontal bridge or railing lines
curving bank outlines
small dark shrub masses along the island
light water gaps around the bank
delicate twiggy tree strokes

motifs.name: lower_left_riverside_pavilions
motifs.description: Foreground-left riverside architectural compound with multiple sloped roofs, walls, terrace edge, small gate-like structure, and overhanging trees beside the water.
must_preserve: layered tiled roof shapes
straight architectural wall and terrace lines
small gate or landing element at lower edge
dense dark foliage overlapping roofs
adjacent waterline and bank contour

motifs.name: lower_right_pine_grove_and_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Lower-right foreground grove of tall dark pines and trees on a sandy rocky bank, with exposed trunks, clustered canopies, shrubs, rocks, and a few pinkish blossom accents at the far right.
must_preserve: tall tree trunks with dark ink bases
dense pine needle clusters and rounded foliage masses
sandy bank wash and rock contours
small shrubs and grasses at tree bases
subtle pink blossom/color accents on the right edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
